items.title: Empire Of The Sun Singer Says “Of Course” He Uses AI
items.summary: I think we've reached the point of exhaustion with artists talking about AI but not having anything novel or even coherent to say. In a recent interview with iHeartRadio at the Osheaga Festival, Empire Of The Sun's Luke Steele was asked if he used AI, and he responded, "Of course!" Although his answer was enthusiastic, the conversation that followed quickly lost steam.

items.title: Jason Calhoun – “enjoy losing”
items.summary: Jason Calhoun is a Philadelphia-based ambient artist and composer who's getting ready to share revelations of divine love, his fifth release for Dear Life Records. So far he's previewed the album with the meditative slices "tolstoy tatsoi," "what we deserve," and "at home," and today he's back with "enjoy losing," a pleasant, cosmic blip inspired by playing chess on his phone.
